name: Procurement - Vendor Evaluation

parameters.query: SELECT v.id, v.name, v.tenant_id, COUNT(po.id) as total_orders, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (po.delivery_date - po.expected_delivery_date))/86400) as avg_delay_days, SUM(po.total_amount) as total_spend, cfg.channel_id FROM pro_vendors v JOIN pro_purchase_orders po ON po.vendor_id = v.id AND po.status = 'DELIVERED' AND po.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '3 months' JOIN pro_config cfg ON cfg.tenant_id = v.tenant_id WHERE v.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY v.id, v.name, v.tenant_id, cfg.channel_id HAVING COUNT(po.id) > 0;

INSERT INTO pro_vendor_evaluations (tenant_id, vendor_id, period, total_orders, avg_delay_days, total_spend, evaluated_at) VALUES ($1,$2,date_trunc('quarter',NOW()),$3,$4,$5,NOW()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, vendor_id, period) DO UPDATE SET total_orders=$3, avg_delay_days=$4, total_spend=$5;
